reason: A web interface plugin that adds a conversation-header panel showing actual models, reasoning effort, names, providers, and runtime status for the current session and its agent tree.

summaries.zh: 在会话标题栏中显示当前会话及其子代理实际使用的模型、推理档位和运行状态。
summaries.en: Adds a conversation-header panel showing the actual models, reasoning effort, and runtime status of the current session and its subagents.

capabilities: Reads current and persisted agent request headers
Enumerates parent and subagent session metadata
Adds a conversation-header button and popup panel
Polls the local endpoint every two seconds
